# Grand piano analysis reference

Salamander Grand Piano V3, Yamaha C5. Author: Alexander Holm.
Source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano
Pinned commit: 3382bf9496bba2486f5ab0de55a264d1dfc38404
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Changes: offline mono-channel alignment, selected modal/hammer analysis, shared
temporal-basis compression, retuning, quantization and gain calibration.
No recording playback is performed by the FPGA. Runtime files contain synthesis
coefficients, generic sine/control curves and oscillator state only.
The original source is not represented as author-endorsed or unchanged.
